metadata.title: Supply Chain Enforcement / Gatekeeper SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan governing enforcement points that translate advisory supply-chain trust signals into explicit allow/deny decisions, without minting trust or overriding safety, runtime, or governance authorities.

import-profile.remarks: This SSPP enforces decisions derived from Supply Chain Relying SSPPs and explicitly forbids implicit authorization paths.

system-characteristics.system-description: The Supply Chain Enforcement / Gatekeeper SSPP governs technical and procedural control points where supply-chain trust signals are evaluated and enforced. It converts contextual inputs into explicit allow, deny, or require-human-approval outcomes, while preventing trust persistence, authority inheritance, or safety bypass.

props.name: system-role
props.remarks: This system enforces decisions but does not originate trust or risk acceptance.

props.name: authority-boundary
props.remarks: Gatekeepers must not create, elevate, or persist trust.

props.name: decision-mode
props.remarks: All outcomes must be explicit: allow, deny, or escalate.

props.name: non-equivalence
props.remarks: No single supply-chain signal is sufficient for allow decisions.

props.name: precedence-rule
props.remarks: Secure‑SDLC, Secure‑Resilience, and Safety Governance SSPPs override gatekeeper outcomes.

props.name: forbidden-behavior
props.remarks: Implicit or default allow behaviors are forbidden.

system-implementation.remarks: Gatekeepers operate as enforcement points within pipelines, access brokers, deployment systems, and integration layers. They consume inputs from relying SSPPs and negative-pattern SSPPs and produce auditable decisions.

components.title: Relying System Inputs
components.remarks: Consumes advisory trust interpretations from IT, OT, and IoMT relying systems.

components.title: Negative‑Pattern Enforcement
components.remarks: Explicitly denies architectures or flows defined as forbidden.

components.title: Secure‑SDLC Alignment
components.remarks: Build, test, and deployment controls override supply-chain inputs.

roles.title: DevOps Enforcement Operations
roles.remarks: Operates pipeline gates and deployment controls.

roles.title: Security Architecture
roles.remarks: Ensures enforcement logic preserves architectural boundaries.

roles.title: Audit & Assurance
roles.remarks: Validates that enforcement decisions are explicit and traceable.

control-implementation.remarks: Controls are enforced across NIST SP 800‑53r5 SA, SR, CM, AC, IA, PL, RA, and SI families. Enforcement logic requires multiple corroborating inputs and denies on uncertainty.
